content.short: Anton Analytics is an open-source indexer and analytical tool for deep exploration of TON on-chain data.
content.description: Anton Analytics is a powerful, open-source blockchain indexer and data analysis platform built specifically for the TON blockchain. It enables developers and analysts to perform deep queries on the network's history, providing structured access to blocks, transactions, and account states. By leveraging tools like Apache Superset for visualization, Anton Analytics allows for the creation of sophisticated dashboards and reports, making it a vital resource for tracking ecosystem health, protocol performance, and network-wide trends on TON.
